proof_summary: The defining sum gives the recurrence \(a(n+1)=(2^n-1)a(n)+2^{\binom{n+1}{2}}\); for odd \(p\), Fermat’s theorem and the shift formula for the triangular exponent make its coefficients periodic modulo \(p\), while a direct evaluation of the shifted base case kills every summand but the last, so induction propagates the congruence. For \(p=2\), the same recurrence shows inductively that every term from index \(1\) onward is odd.
